statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let J := fun (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ → ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (v u:ℂ)*S n (high n) u*S n (high n) u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → -(n:ℝ)/576 ≤ J n (K n)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：冻结筛权与弧后，对称二次幂移频平均守住 n/576 预算
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a symmetric binary frequency packet stays above −n/576

brief.zh: 余弦给出 n±2^j 的对称平均。固定同一个 n 的素数和、截断和弧，只移动系数频率；不可直接代入邻居各自的表示数。先尝试对稀疏频谱作均方估计。
brief.en: Cosines average symmetric frequency shifts. Hold the prime sum, cutoff and arcs fixed at n. Try mean-square estimates for the sparse packet. Neighboring representation counts use different data.
